title: Bridge Repair
description: Find which equations can be satisfied with +, *, and concatenation operators.
writeup:
## Approach

Each line gives a target value and a list of numbers. Operators are inserted left-to-right between numbers (no precedence rules — always evaluated left to right).

## Part 1

Recursively try placing `+` or `*` between each pair of numbers, reducing left to right. If any combination produces the target, the equation is valid.

## Part 2

A third operator `||` (concatenation) is added, e.g. `12 || 34 = 1234`. The same recursive approach works with three branches instead of two. Pruning isn't strictly needed since the number of operands per line is small.
